title: Remove FuzzManagerReporter.quality
description: The quality member was not reset properly after submitting reports. It does not need to be a member and can report the quality value incorrectly.

comments.author: codecov[bot]
comments.body:
## [Codecov](https://app.codecov.io/gh/MozillaSecurity/grizzly/pull/441?dropdown=coverage&src=pr&el=h1&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=github&utm_content=comment&utm_campaign=pr+comments&utm_term=MozillaSecurity) Report
